eas_text: A civil authority has issued A LOCAL AREA EMERGENCY for the following counties or areas: Lincoln, NM; at 3:15 PM on SEP 17, 2026 Effective until 7:15 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Lincoln County Emergency Management: Flash Flooding is OBSERVED in the Turkey Canyon area Rapidly rising floodwaters have been reported in Ruidoso Downs along River Lane. Rapidly rising floodwaters may impact roadways and low-lying areas. For your safety avoid travel and move immediately to higher ground! Do not delay leaving to gather any belongings or make efforts to protect your home.
